proposed_rule.strategy: Explicit lookup of each cited printed page to zero-based pdf_index and scan_side using cited_targets.
proposed_rule.pdf_fragment_rule: For every target, the full original spread is available at pdf.url + #page=(pdf_index + 1).
proposed_rule.do_not_use: Do not assume printed_page equals PDF index, apply one global offset, equate two physical sides with two consecutive printed numbers, or infer pagination from entry numbers.
proposed_rule.critical_insertion: PDF index 21 contains printed 38 on the left and an unnumbered manuscript facsimile on the right. PDF index 22 contains a blank left leaf and printed 39 on the right. Printed 40 and 41 are at index 23, not index 22.
proposed_rule.second_part_insertion: After index 23 (printed 40–41), index 24 has the unnumbered Segunda Parte / Português-Tupi divider on the right and index 25 is blank. At index 26, a manuscript facsimile is on the left and printed 45 is on the right. Do not assign printed 42–44 to these sides merely to fill a sequence.

citation_baseline.method: Count explicit Castilho, Nomes references in definition field d before the BIBLIOGRAFIA record, preserving original record indices and lemma field f.
citation_baseline.current_link_state: The main-baseline linker has no Castilho source handler. Do not treat this plan as already deployed.

preferred_strategy.name: cited_page_crops
preferred_strategy.composition: Render the complete PDF page composition with the selected clipping rectangle; preserve all contributing image masks and PDF text overlays. Do not extract only one embedded bitmap.
preferred_strategy.crop_coordinates: PDF points, origin at the top left, within the 792×612 page box. A working gutter coordinate is recorded per source spread; keep a 4-point overlap into the gutter on either side, retain full y=0..612 and the outer margin. These are deliberately page crops, not tight text-only crops.
preferred_strategy.resampling: Scale the clipped page to 1200 px wide while preserving its aspect ratio. If raster rounding yields 1201 px, resize once with Lanczos. Keep the complete source PDF available for maximum-resolution reading.
preferred_strategy.navigation: Use the ordered available printed targets [27..41,45], label any jump as an available-page jump, and offer the original PDF for uncached neighbors. Never increment directly to an ungenerated p42.jpg or silently display a different page.
preferred_strategy.context_and_credit: Always show the digitization credit and catalog link, plus the full original spread link at #page=(pdf_index+1). Link the title/credit spread at #page=3 and the digitizer notice at #page=4. The original PDF preserves the facing manuscript and intervening leaves without storing duplicate full-spread images.

alternative_strategy.name: all_original_spreads
alternative_strategy.navigation: Browse PDF indices 0..69. On citation entry, load its verified spread and identify/focus the left or right target. For unverified non-cited positions show scan positions rather than made-up printed page numbers.
alternative_strategy.context_and_credit: Preserves all facing context, blank leaves, facsimiles and existing title/notice overlays automatically. Do not also require a second set of page crops.
alternative_strategy.optimizer_caveat: The current Pages image optimizer caps width at 1800 and recompresses to JPEG quality 82. Measurements below include that actual path; it reduces per-side resolution. If full-spread assets are served externally at 2400 px, keep that policy separate from legacy Pages defaults.

measurement.estimate_limits: Estimates exclude metadata, thumbnails, caches and previous immutable asset versions. They do not include the 11.66 MB source PDF, which remains external. Samples are selected examples, not a random sample or a measured complete book.

local_agent_actions: Read AGENTS.md and the shared primary-source storage handoff. Treat this JSON as research input, not as a deployable source.json or an instruction to run the existing renderer unchanged.

Download the exact institutional PDF outside the repository, verify its SHA-256, byte count and 70-page count, and recheck the title at PDF index 2 before reusing the mapping. Stop and investigate if the source file differs.

Regenerate the citation inventory from the served gzip dataset. Confirm the recorded hash and 215 occurrences across 162 records, or explain changes. Preserve dictionary data and all existing source mappings.

Choose either the 16 cited crops or all 70 whole spreads, following the shared asset-storage plan. Keep the original PDF external and avoid requiring both derivative sets. Use measured complete output totals in the implementation PR, not this sample estimate as an exact budget.

For crops, deliberately implement or extend the renderer to consume explicit crop bounds and printed-page output names. The current render_source_pages.py only renders whole PDF indices and does not understand this plan’s mapping or crop schema.

Verify each of the 16 output targets, including complete bracketed page labels, text blocks and diacritics. Retain all source layers during composition. In particular, keep the inserted facsimile at index 21 from being misidentified as page 39 and keep page 45 at index 26/right.

Create a reviewed runtime manifest with the verified edition, source hash, citation map, chosen asset URLs and dimensions. Implement a dedicated Castilho/Nomes citation handler preserving displayed text and leaving unrelated sources unchanged.

Implement mode-appropriate navigation: available-page jumps/PDF fallback for a crop subset, or scan 0..69 browsing and target-side focus for full spreads. Retain reload/share URLs and accurate distinctions between printed pages, manuscript inserts and scan indices.

Add focused tests that execute the production citation/viewer path and cover all 215 baseline citations. Include independent anchor assertions for 27→15/right, 38→21/left, 39→22/right, 40→23/left, 41→23/right and 45→26/right; source PDF fragments must use index + 1.

In a real browser, inspect the îybaypy result and its page 45 image/PDF page 27; inspect a page 39 target and PDF page 23; check mobile/desktop fit, zoom, missing-image behavior and available navigation. Verify existing D’Evreux and legacy source links still work.

Include actual derivative sizes, representative screenshots, source credit, the complete verified locator table and unresolved non-cited pagination limits in the implementation PR. Keep this groundwork PR free of image/PDF binaries.
